from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ContractLiabilityRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's contract liability data from a single quarterly financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as stated in the report")
    contract_liability_amount: float | None = Field(description="The contract liability amount at period end in yuan")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    report_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of report, e.g., '2024年第一季度财务报告'")
    balance_sheet_section: str | None = Field(description="Where the figure is located, e.g., '合并资产负债表流动负债部分'")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    contract_liability_records: list[ContractLiabilityRecord]
